Markets are probably in the early phase of a crypto winter, echoing bitcoin’s historical four-year cycle, according to a year-end report by analyst Brett Knoblauch. Bitcoin is roughly 85 days past its peak, and Knoblauch suggests prices could remain under pressure for months, possibly even testing Strategy’s (MSTR) average breakeven price near $75,000.

The coming year may not offer crypto’s next big breakout. But the groundwork for more durable infrastructure and deeper institutional adoption appears to be solidifying even as prices cool.

Bitcoin just pushed past $90,000, and suddenly an old, heavy position is back in the spotlight. This is the same massive whale who flipped bearish right after the 10/11 flash crash, and for a while the pain was… brutal. Now though, the damage has eased a bit. The total floating loss has narrowed to roughly $21.6 million. Still ugly, but not catastrophic anymore.
What’s wild is how long this trader has been willing to sit through it.

title: Groundbreaking Move China Will Pay Interest on Digital Yuan to Boost Adoption
subTitle:
China is taking a major step to accelerate adoption of its digital currency by allowing commercial banks to pay interest on digital yuan (e-CNY) balances. The decision is part of a broader push to strengthen China’s financial system and advance the role of the digital yuan in everyday use.
The announcement was made by Lu Lei, Vice Governor of the People’s Bank of China, who confirmed that the policy will take effect on January 1. This initiative aligns with the Chinese Communist Party’s 15th Five-Year Plan, which calls for the steady expansion of the digital yuan.
In a recent article, Lu explained that the central bank plans to introduce incentives that position the digital yuan not only as a payment tool, but also as a savings option. Under the new rules, banks will calculate and pay interest on balances held in real-name digital RMB wallets, following existing guidelines on deposit interest rate pricing.
He also noted that banks will be allowed to manage digital yuan balances as part of their asset-liability operations, and that digital currency deposits will receive the same protections as traditional bank deposits.
Although the digital yuan has made progress, adoption has been slower than expected due to strong competition from existing payment platforms already favored by Chinese consumers. By offering interest, authorities hope to make the digital yuan more attractive and place it on equal footing with regular bank deposits.
That said, the impact may be limited. Deposit interest rates in China are currently very low  reportedly around 0.05% — which means the financial incentive itself is modest.
Despite this, usage continues to grow. Since November 2025, the digital yuan has processed over 3.48 billion transactions, with a total transaction value nearing 17 trillion yuan.

Digital Yuan Moves Closer to Traditional Bank Deposits
Starting January 1, as part of the Chinese Communist Party’s 15th Five-Year Plan for Economic and Social Development, the digital yuan will gain features similar to regular bank deposits. The plan emphasizes the “steady development of the digital yuan” as a core national objective.
Lu Lei, Vice Governor of the Bank of China, confirmed that banks will calculate and pay interest on balances held in real-name digital RMB wallets, following existing deposit interest rate regulations. This move positions the digital yuan not just as a payment tool, but also as a savings instrument.
Same Protection as Traditional Deposits
Lei also highlighted that digital yuan balances will be included in banks’ asset-liability management systems, meaning digital currency deposits will enjoy the same protections as traditional bank deposits—a significant confidence booster for users.
Adoption Challenges Remain
Despite these incentives, China’s payment ecosystem is already dominated by popular platforms, making widespread adoption challenging. Moreover, deposit interest rates in China remain extremely low—currently around 0.05%, according to Bloomberg—so the immediate financial incentive may be limited.
Strong Usage Metrics Signal Growth
Even so, adoption continues to grow. Since November 2025, the digital yuan has processed over 3.48 billion transactions, with a total transaction value nearing 17 trillion yuan, underscoring its expanding role in China’s digital economy.

Fifth rule: Always keep your positions light, don't fantasize about changing your fate in one go. With light positions, your mindset is stable;

Remember:

Contracts are not a shortcut to getting rich overnight, but a practice to test whether you can survive in the long run. Engrave these five rules into your bones, and you'll find that the market becomes increasingly friendly to you.

The market is never short of opportunities; what's lacking are those who are not blind, not impulsive, can wait, can endure, and can stop.

The broader issue goes beyond crypto alone: can the US remain competitive in a fast-moving, digital-first global economy?

title: The VC Hype Bubble Is Bursting: Why Many Crypto Projects Are Collapsing in 2025
subTitle:
During the 2025 “risk-on” recovery phase, crypto venture capital (VC) firms deployed billions of dollars into early-stage token projects, betting heavily on narratives, rapid adoption, and future network effects. However, as these tokens enter public markets, a harsh reality is emerging: many are now trading far below their private-round valuations.
The growing gap between VC-implied valuations and real public market capitalization signals a broader market reset—one that suggests narrative-driven optimism is losing its grip as liquidity, fundamentals, and real demand take center stage.
Recent data shared by CryptoRank reveals that dozens of heavily backed projects have lost hundreds of millions of dollars in implied value, and in extreme cases, nearly all of their private-round valuation evaporated shortly after launch. This has reignited debate around valuation discipline during overheated growth cycles.
When VC Valuations Meet Market Reality
A comparison between VC valuations and current market caps paints a clear and uncomfortable picture.
Humanity Protocol, once valued at $1 billion in private rounds, now trades at approximately $285 million.
Plasma (XPL) shows a similar pattern, with a current market cap near $224 million versus a $500 million VC valuation.
ICNT trades around $247 million, down from a $470 million private valuation.
While these declines are significant, they pale in comparison to the most dramatic collapses.
Projects such as Fuel Network, Double Zero, and Bubblemaps—the latter known for publicly mocking rapper Soulja Boy over his past crypto and NFT promotions—were once valued at around or above $1 billion. Today, they trade near $11 million, $373,000, and $6 million, respectively.
Similarly:
Camp Network fell from $400 million to roughly $15 million
TreeHouse declined from $400 million to about $16 million
Privasea saw one of the steepest drops, collapsing from $180 million to nearly $1 million
These figures underscore how quickly private optimism can unravel once exposed to public market price discovery.
Not All Projects Collapse — But the Damage Is Widespread
Importantly, not every VC-backed project has imploded.
SosoValue has held relatively firm, maintaining a market cap around $152 million versus a $200 million private valuation.
Yieldbasis trades near $34 million, down modestly from $50 million.
Momentum and Bitlight sit in the middle of the spectrum, with current market caps of approximately $43 million and $34 million, compared to VC valuations of $100 million and $170 million, respectively.
These examples suggest that projects with clearer utility, sustainable token economics, or consistent user demand tend to weather post-launch valuation compression better than purely narrative-driven plays.
VC Funding Is Recovering — But Euphoria Is Being Replaced by Caution
The valuation reset is occurring despite a clear recovery in crypto venture funding.
According to CryptoRank:
Total quarterly VC investment surged to ~$10 billion in Q2 2025, the highest level since early 2022
Funding remained strong at nearly $8 billion across Q3 and Q4
For context, VC funding bottomed out at around $689 million in Q3 2023, then stabilized between $1–2.5 billion throughout most of 2024.
The 2025 recovery coincided with Bitcoin’s sharp rally, as BTC climbed above $126,000 mid-year before cooling into the $80,000–$100,000 range toward year-end.
However, timing matters.
The largest capital deployments occurred in Q2 2025, precisely when market sentiment was most optimistic and token prices were accelerating. CryptoRank data shows that many projects funded during this peak enthusiasm phase now trade far below their VC-backed valuations.
A Structural Shift in Market Expectations
For many investors, the takeaway is not that venture capital has “returned,” but rather that public markets are no longer willing to blindly validate private-round narratives.
As several analysts on X have pointed out, the widening gap between VC valuations and real trading data is increasingly viewed as a risk signal, not a badge of confidence.
This shift highlights a maturing market dynamic:
Liquidity matters more than promises
Token supply mechanics matter more than pitch decks
Sustainable demand matters more than headline valuations
As capital continues to flow back into crypto, expectations are being recalibrated, forcing both VCs and founders to confront tougher pricing realities.
Final Thoughts
The collapse of many VC-backed crypto projects in 2025 does not necessarily signal the end of innovation—but it does mark the end of unchecked narrative-driven valuation inflation.
As public markets assert their role as the ultimate arbiter of value, discipline, transparency, and realistic pricing are becoming unavoidable. For investors, understanding the divergence between private optimism and public reality may be just as important as spotting the next big trend.

title: Is Ethereum Heading Toward $5,000? History Suggests a Powerful Pattern Is Repeating
subTitle:
Could Ethereum (ETH) be preparing for another explosive rally toward the $5,000 mark? Recent on-chain and technical signals are drawing strong parallels to previous periods that preceded major ETH price surges of up to 120%.
One of the most notable developments is happening quietly beneath the surface: the Ethereum staking inflow queue has once again surpassed the unstaking (withdrawal) queue—a phenomenon that historically occurred just before strong bullish moves.
Ethereum Validator Entry Queue Surpasses Exit Queue
According to the latest data, Ethereum’s staking queue has grown to 745,619 ETH, worth approximately $2.2 billion, with an estimated waiting period of 13 days. This marks the first time since June that the amount of ETH waiting to be staked has exceeded the amount waiting to be withdrawn.
By comparison, the exit (unstaking) queue currently stands at 360,528 ETH, equivalent to roughly $1.06 billion. This shift signals a renewed preference among validators to lock ETH for the long term, reducing liquid supply and potential sell pressure in the market.
Notably, this is also the highest level of validator staking registrations since November 30. Data from ValidatorQueue shows that the number of active Ethereum validators has exceeded 983,371, with approximately 29.3% of the total ETH supply now staked, or around 35.5 million ETH.
Why This Matters: Improved Staking Dynamics After Pectra Upgrade
On-chain analyst DeFiIgnas commented on X that the validator entry queue has officially overtaken the exit queue, explaining that the Pectra upgrade significantly improved the staking experience.
Key improvements include:
Increased maximum validator limits
Easier restaking for large ETH holders
Improved operational efficiency for institutional validators
These changes make Ethereum staking more attractive for long-term capital, particularly from large players, reinforcing the idea that ETH is being accumulated rather than distributed.
Echoing this view, Abdul, Head of DeFi at Monad Foundation, noted that this is the first time in six months that the entry queue has exceeded the exit queue. He added that the last occurrence in June was followed by a near 100% rally in ETH price shortly afterward.
Historical Precedent: Staking Imbalance Before Major Rallies
TradingView data highlights that the two most recent instances where ETH staking inflows exceeded outflows—March and June—both occurred just before major price increases of approximately 90% and 126%, respectively.
This historical correlation does not guarantee future performance, but it does strengthen the case that rising staking participation often coincides with bullish market phases, especially when combined with favorable network conditions such as:
Increased on-chain activity
Reduced effective supply
Lower transaction fees
Strong validator confidence
If similar dynamics persist, a move toward $5,000 ETH in 2026 becomes a plausible scenario rather than a speculative fantasy.
$5,000 ETH Target Based on a 2024 Fractal Setup
From a technical perspective, Ethereum’s current price structure closely resembles the setup that triggered a powerful rally in Q4 2024.
At that time, ETH consolidated between $2,260 and $2,750 from July to October before breaking out and surging 74.5% to $4,100 by December 2024.
Today, ETH is displaying a similar sideways structure within the $2,750–$3,200 range. If price continues to hold above the critical $2,750 support, a comparable upside expansion of approximately 75% could project ETH toward the $5,100–$5,200 zone, mirroring the previous fractal.
Key Technical Level to Watch
Well-known analyst Titan of Crypto notes that ETH has now retraced approximately 61.8% from its most recent impulse move, a Fibonacci level historically associated with strong reactions.
He emphasizes that $2,750 is the key level to monitor in the coming weeks, as it represents the structural foundation for any sustained bullish continuation—similar to what was observed in mid-2024.
Caution Still Required: Bull Trap Risks Remain
Despite the growing number of bullish signals, some industry analysts remain cautious. As previously reported by Coinphoton, there are concerns that Ethereum could still form a bull trap if macro conditions deteriorate or if risk appetite weakens across broader markets.
As always, on-chain strength and technical confluence increase probability—not certainty.
Final Thoughts
The convergence of:
Rising staking inflows
Reduced unstaking pressure
Improved validator economics
A historically proven technical fractal
creates a compelling bullish narrative for Ethereum over the medium to long term. If history rhymes, ETH reaching $5,000 by 2026 is well within the realm of possibility—but confirmation will depend on key levels holding and broader market conditions aligning.

title: The Premature Token: Why AI Agents Must Earn Their Right to Launch a Coin.
subTitle:
The crypto world has a playbook: build a protocol, launch a token. This instinct has now infected the burgeoning field of AI agents. While decentralized AI and crypto are natural allies, the reflexive rush to tokenize every project is a critical error that confuses fundraising with functionality and puts the cart before the horse.
Tokens Are a Tool, Not the Product
Crypto provides the perfect settlement layer for AI—a transparent, automated way to pay for computational tasks, data, and services. An AI agent can perfectly well charge fees in ETH, SOL, or BNB. Creating a bespoke token at inception adds zero functional utility. It is, at this stage, purely a financial and marketing instrument, not a technical necessity.
The Distraction Economy: Lessons from Web3 Gaming
History is clear. The "play-to-earn" gaming model collapsed because founders focused relentlessly on tokenomics, staking, and inflationary rewards while the actual games were unengaging and unsustainable. The token became the entire product, and when speculation faded, nothing of value remained. AI agents are on the same path, risking a future of "interact-to-earn" bots with impressive token charts and useless functionality.
The Right Sequence: Utility → Scale → Governance
A token should be a crown, not a crutch. It should be introduced to solve a problem that emerges after success, not to manufacture hype before it.
Build Utility First: Create an AI agent that solves a real, painful problem so well that users are willing to pay for it in any currency.Achieve Real Adoption: Scale to a point where a decentralized community could genuinely contribute to and govern the project's future direction.Tokenize for a Purpose: Only then, introduce a token with a clear, non-speculative function—like governing model upgrades, allocating compute resources, or sharing protocol fees. This transforms the token from a speculative asset into a utility-based access key.
The Hard Truth: Most Tokens Are Founder Exits
Let's be blunt: for many early-stage projects, a token launch is a liquidity event for founders and early investors, disguised as community building. It transfers risk from the builders to the users before the product is proven. AI development, while computationally expensive, often does not require the massive, upfront war chests that token sales generate. This misalignment incentivizes marketing over engineering.
Conclusion: The Path to Credibility
The most credible and durable AI agents in the crypto space will be those that earn their token. They will follow a simple, unfashionable mantra: Build something people use. Scale it. Then, and only then, decentralize it. In the long run, the market will not reward AI agents with great tokenomics. It will reward AI agents that deliver great value. The token, if it ever comes, will simply be the proof of that achievement.
The core thesis remains: Crypto is the future infrastructure for AI economies. But an asset for every agent is a bug, not a feature. True innovation lies in building indispensable agents first—the tokens can wait. #BTC  #bnb  #ETH

title: Don't Take the Bait: The Essential Guide to Understanding & Defeating Phishing.
subTitle:
In an era where a single click can compromise your entire digital life, phishing remains the most pervasive and effective form of online attack. It succeeds not by exploiting software flaws, but by manipulating human psychology—making every person both the target and the primary line of defense. This guide deconstructs the anatomy of a phishing scam and arms you with the practical knowledge to render them powerless.
The Unseen Weapon: Why Phishing Works
Phishing’s power comes from its exploitation of trust and urgency. Attackers masquerade as trusted entities—your bank, your boss, a popular service—to bypass your logical defenses. The mechanism follows a predictable, high-pressure pattern:
The Hook: You receive a communication (email, text, call) that appears legitimate and creates a compelling reason to act now—a security alert, a failed payment, a time-sensitive request from leadership.The Line: The message directs you to a malicious link or attachment. Modern attacks use AI-generated content and deepfake audio to make this facade nearly flawless.The Sinker: Clicking leads to a fake login page or malware installation, where your sensitive data (passwords, financial details, crypto keys) is harvested.
The Evolving Threat: From Blunt Scams to Targeted Traps
While generic "Dear Customer" scams still exist, the most dangerous attacks are highly personalized:
Spear Phishing & Whaling: Targeted at specific individuals or high-value executives (CEOs, CFOs), using information from social media and data breaches to craft irresistibly credible messages.Clone Phishing: Attackers copy a legitimate email you've previously received (like an invoice or notification), but replace its safe links with malicious ones.Pharming: A more sinister cousin that hijacks your internet traffic itself, redirecting you to fake websites even when you type the correct URL, often through compromised routers or DNS settings.
Your Digital Immune System: How to Build Unbreakable Habits
Defense is built on a foundation of healthy skepticism and simple, consistent actions:
Verify, Don't Trust: Never click links in unsolicited messages. Instead, manually navigate to the official website by typing the address yourself or using a saved bookmark.Inspect the Details: Hover over links to preview the true URL. Check sender email addresses carefully for subtle misspellings (e.g., support@binançe.com).Question Urgency: Legitimate institutions almost never demand immediate action via email. Treat any message pressuring you to act quickly with extreme suspicion.Adopt Core Security Tools:Use a Password Manager: It auto-fills credentials only on the correct, saved websites, making fake sites ineffective.Enable Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA): This ensures a stolen password alone is useless.Keep Software Updated: This patches vulnerabilities that phishing-linked malware exploits.
The Crypto-Specific Trap: Guarding Your Digital Assets
In blockchain environments, the stakes are especially high. Attacks focus on stealing private keys, seed phrases, and deceptive smart contract approvals. The immutable nature of transactions means stolen funds are often irrecoverable.
The Golden Rule: Your seed phrase should never be typed, stored, or transmitted digitally. No legitimate support agent will ever ask for it. Always double-check wallet addresses and contract details before approving any transaction.
Phishing is a test of vigilance, not just technology. Its methods will continue to evolve with AI and new platforms, but its core weakness remains: it requires you to participate. By adopting a mindset of "trust, but verify," and layering smart habits with basic security tools, you transform from a potential victim into an impassable barrier. In the digital world, your awareness is your strongest firewall. Stay skeptical, stay informed, and stay SAFU. #BTC #ETH  #bnb  #zec

title: THIS IS UNPRECEDENTED — AND IT’S A SERIOUS WARNING
subTitle:
THIS IS UNPRECEDENTED — AND IT’S A SERIOUS WARNING
I’ve spent the last several hours digging into this data, and what I found is deeply concerning.
Global silver production is roughly 800 million ounces per year.
Yet Bank of America and Citi are reportedly holding combined short positions of 4.4 BILLION ounces.
This isn’t just an aggressive trade — it represents a potential systemic risk to the silver market.
THE CORE PROBLEM: SUPPLY VS. PAPER CLAIMS
At current production levels, covering a 4.4 billion ounce short would require every ounce of global silver output for more than 5 years — assuming zero usage elsewhere.
That’s impossible.
Silver isn’t just an investment metal:
~60% of annual supply is consumed by industrial demand
Solar, electronics, medical, and defense sectors rely on it
The amount of freely available, investment-grade silver is extremely limited
These positions are not backed by real metal. They are backed by paper claims.
HOW IS THIS POSSIBLE?
Through:
Unallocated silver accounts
Rehypothecation (the same physical silver being promised to multiple parties)
This structure works only as long as investors are willing to settle in cash and never demand delivery.
But if confidence breaks — if a large institution or sovereign entity demands physical silver — the system faces immediate stress.
WHY THIS IS DIFFERENT FROM HISTORY
This is not a repeat of the 1980 Hunt Brothers episode.
The Hunts tried to corner silver by buying physical metal
This situation is the opposite: massive institutional naked short exposure
The scale is unlike anything seen before.
WHAT COULD HAPPEN NEXT
In a true short squeeze scenario:
Exchanges may move to cash-only settlement
Paper silver prices may remain controlled
Physical silver prices could decouple and reprice sharply higher
That would create two separate markets:
Paper silver — liquid but disconnected from reality
Physical silver — scarce and potentially repriced vertically
THE KEY TAKEAWAY
If you don’t hold the metal, you don’t truly own it.
This isn’t a prediction — it’s a structural risk that already exists.
When confidence breaks, it won’t be gradual.
It will be sudden.

The "big whale" is moving, but the data beneath the surface tells a more nuanced story than simple selling. BlackRock's move of **2,201 BTC and 7,557 ETH to Coinbase Prime** on Dec. 29 is significant, but it’s happening in the context of heavy, sustained ETF outflows that have reached **$3.2 billion since October**.
Here’s my read: This is likely a strategic rebalancing or liquidity provision by BlackRock, not a panic sell. Their IBIT ETF alone saw **$435 million in net outflows last week**, and a large transfer to their custodian partner (Coinbase Prime) is a standard operational move to facilitate those redemptions. The real story is the **capital rotation** happening. While $BTC and $ETH products bleed, **XRP and Solana ETPs saw inflows of $70.2M and $7.5M last week**. This isn't capital leaving crypto; it's moving to new, high-conviction narratives.
The takeaway? Institutional activity is becoming more tactical and complex. Large transfers during outflows signal caution, but the simultaneous flows into alt-coin ETFs show a market that’s selectively bullish, not bearish.
Are we witnessing the start of a major rotation cycle, or just year-end portfolio shuffling?

title: 2025年度总结，市场虽然发生一些戏剧性事件，但也是CEX和DEX权利交接年。
subTitle:
上一篇我们聊了散户的至暗时刻，见证了杠杆清洗的残酷。但硬币的另一面是，2025年也是加密市场基础设施全面胜利的一年。当喧嚣的散户退场，留下的空间迅速被更成熟、更去中心化的力量填满。
这一年，市场完成了从“交易所主导”到“链上主导”的权力交接，其结构健康度达到了过去十五年未有的高度。
1. 权力的交接：从“交易所”到“链上生态”
2025年最深刻的变革，是中心化交易所光环的彻底褪去，以及链上原生力量的全面崛起。
去中心化交易所的市场份额在这一年达到了历史顶峰。这不仅仅是Hyperliquid等协议的胜利，更是整个链上交易理念的胜利。资金不再需要通过“托管”就能完成高效的流转。
无论是现货还是衍生品，链上交易量都呈现了指数级增长。这意味着，市场定价权正在从交易所的订单簿，向链上的流动性池转移。透明、抗审查、7x24小时不间断的链上市场，成为了新的交易主战场。
2. 预测市场：从“边缘赌局”到“机构指标”
预测市场在社交媒体的讨论度超过所有交易所总和”的现象，绝非偶然，而是市场成熟度的标志性事件。链上预测市场经过五年的迭代，已经从边缘的“赌局”进化成了全球宏观叙事的“晴雨表”。
如今，它成为了传统大型机构使用的指标。无论是政治选举还是宏观经济数据，预测市场的价格发现速度比传统金融市场更快、更准。它不再只是“赌”，而是一种高度有效的信息聚合与定价工具，其社交媒体热度正是这种新权力中心的体现。
3. 稳定币：突破3000亿的“数字基石”
稳定币总量突破3000亿美元大关，这一数据具有里程碑式的意义，它标志着加密货币从“资产”向“货币”功能的实质性跨越。这3000亿美元不再仅仅是进出市场的“通道资金”。它正在成为全球贸易和支付的“底层结算层”。随着现实世界资产的兴起，稳定币成为了连接传统金融收益（如美债、票据等）与链上世界的最佳载体。它不再依附于加密市场的涨跌，而是与全球流动性深度绑定，成为了真正的“数字基石”。
4. 迎来一个更成熟、更“无感”的金融系统
基于2025年的这些结构性改变，我们可以勾勒出未来的图景，随着DEX和跨链技术的成熟，用户将不再感知到“中心化交易所”的存在，交易将成为应用内自然发生的行为。
预测市场、稳定币、衍生品，这些都将成为可插拔的金融模块，被无缝集成到各种应用中，传统机构将不再只是“买币”，而是直接在链上进行复杂的金融工程，成为链上生态的“原住民”。

2025年，是加密市场的成人礼，散户的离场虽然伴随着辛酸，却意外地让市场摆脱了“赌场”的标签。当权力从中心化的交易所转移到透明的链上，当预测市场成为全球的晴雨表，当稳定币成为3000亿美元的数字基石，我们便知道，一个更加成熟、更加稳健、也更加融入现实世界的去中心化金融时代，已经全面降临。

顺便感谢CEX过去一年做的荒唐事，让市场更快的转向链上权利交接，五年后DEX交易量注定会超过所有CEX总和。

title: Хотите разогнать счёт? Сначала разгоните свою дисциплину.
subTitle:
«Разогнать счёт» - это не про то, чтобы вложить $100 и вывести $10 000. Это про то, чтобы системно увеличивать объём позиций, не увеличивая процент риска.
Пока вы этого не поняли, вы не разгоняете счёт. Вы его сжигаете.
Правило разгона №0 (главное):
Ваш риск на сделку- всегда фиксированный % от текущего капитала, а не от первоначального.
Было $1 000, риск 1% = $10.
Стало $1 100, риск 1% = $11.
  Капитал растет- растет и размер вашей позиции при том же уровне риска. Это и есть единственно безопасный разгон. Всё остальное - путь к маржин-коллу.
Три стратегии для тех, кто хочет большего (и готов к боли):
1. Стратегия «Пирамида» (для тренда).
Вы вошли,цена пошла в вашу сторону. Вместо того чтобы сразу фиксировать прибыль, вы добавляетесь к позиции на откатах, каждый раз выставляя новый общий стоп-лосс в безубыток.
Что разгоняет: Правильно пойманный тренд приносит в разы больше.
Что взрывает: Жадность. Добавление на поздних стадиях тренда или отсутствие жёсткого правила выхода для всей пирамиды.
2. Стратегия «Парашют» (для выживания).
Выделите5-10% от своего депозита. Это ваш «парашютный» фонд. Торгуйте им с повышенным, но РАССЧИТАННЫМ риском (например, 5% на сделку). Основной капитал трогать нельзя.
Что разгоняет: Если «парашют» сработает, вы резко увеличите общий капитал. Если сольёте - потеряете только его, а основной портфель цел.
Что взрывает: Соблазн добавить к «парашюту» ещё денег после первых успехов.
3. Стратегия «Компрессор» (для хладнокровных).
Ваш риск на сделку- 1%. Но вы фиксируете 50% прибыли на уровне Risk/Reward 1:1. Эти 0.5% прибыли добавляете к следующей сделке как дополнительный риск. Получается микро-компаундинг внутри одной сессии.
Что разгоняет: Силу сложного процента внутри одного торгового дня.
Что взрывает: Желание пропустить этап фиксации и «просто удержать до луны».
Главный индикатор разгона:
Это не график вашего PnL.Это график соблюдения ваших же правил.
Если вы нарушаете свой риск-менеджмент ради«разгона», вы уже проиграли. Вы разгоняете не счёт, а скорость слива.
Если бы вам СЕЙЧАС увеличили депозит в 10 раз - вы бы смогли торговать в ХОРОШЕМ режиме? Или ваша психология сломалась бы, и вы бы всё слили?
Если нет- ваш разгон должен начинаться не с денег, а с тренировки психики на маленьких объёмах.
➜ Подписка - если хотите разбирать не как «сорвать куш», а как строить капитал. Медленно, скучно, зато надолго.

There is only one day left in 2025, looking back at the market this year, it can be described as "a paper full of absurd words and a handful of bitter tears".

In my impression, on the first day of 2025, Bitcoin was at $95,000, Ethereum was at $3,300, and today, as the calendar of 2025 is about to turn, asset prices seem to have returned to near the starting point. But beneath this appearance of a year of seemingly futile efforts, the market has experienced two brutal large-scale deleveraging events, which acted like two scalpels, completely dissecting the facade of the bull market and executing the most brutal cleansing of retail investors.

The first deleveraging occurred during the Spring Festival. It was the first storm of blood and gore in 2025 and created the largest scale of a leveraged cleansing in cryptocurrency history. At that time, market sentiment was infinitely amplified by the optimism at the beginning of the year, especially in the largest MeMe sector, which collapsed amidst the frenzy. That wave of market activity almost plunged into silence, with countless people falling before the arrival of spring.

At that time, everyone thought it was the darkest moment, but no one could have imagined that nine months later, the market would stage another event with a more "black humor" tone. The second deleveraging occurred in October. Its brutality not only reached historical peaks but was more like a carefully planned "black comedy". When Bitcoin reached an all-time high of $126,000, everyone thought it would gallop ahead, but the sudden downturn in October caught the bulls off guard. This wave of cleansing not only took away profits but also the remaining liquidity in the market. Thus, it can be determined that in the past year, retail investors were completely washed out by the market.

The MeMe collapse at the beginning of the year washed away one wave, and the black humor at the end of the year washed away another. What remains may no longer be those retail investors shouting on social media, but a group of survivors who are more silent or, one could say, more mature due to market education.

2025 has made the market more mature, and the so-called institutional market will also arrive. If one has experienced the CEX asset cleanup at the beginning of the year and the black humor in October, for retail investors, most assets should not be used in leverage, but the financial market will always be filled with various temptations, and unless market rules change, no one is obligated to give warnings.

第一次去杠杆，发生在春节。那是2025年的第一场血雨腥风，也创造了币圈历史上最大规模的一次杠杆清洗。当时市场情绪在年初的乐观中被无限放大，尤其是最大的MeMe板块，在狂欢中走向了崩盘。那一波行情，市场几乎陷入了一片死寂，无数人倒在了春天来临之前。

title: Ethereum The Engine Powering the Crypto Economy
subTitle:
Ethereum is not just another cryptocurrency it is the foundation layer of the entire Web3 economy. While Bitcoin proved that decentralized money is possible, Ethereum proved something far more powerful: that code itself can be trustless, autonomous, and global. From DeFi to NFTs, stablecoins to DAOs, Ethereum is the infrastructure that made crypto more than just money.
More Than a Coin — A Global Computer 

Ethereum introduced the world to smart contracts, self-executing programs that run exactly as written, without intermediaries. This single innovation transformed blockchain from a payment experiment into a full financial and technological ecosystem.
Banks, exchanges, lending platforms, games, marketplaces, and even digital identities now run on Ethereum. It is not competing with traditional finance it is quietly rebuilding it from the ground up.

The Heart of DeFi
Ethereum is the undisputed king of decentralized finance. Trillions of dollars in cumulative volume have flowed through Ethereum-based protocols, enabling users to lend, borrow, trade, stake, and earn without banks, borders, or permission.

Stablecoins like USDT and USDC primarily live on Ethereum, making it the settlement layer for global crypto liquidity. When money moves on-chain, it almost always touches Ethereum.
The Smart Money Chain
Institutions didn’t choose Ethereum by accident. It has the largest developer community, the most battle-tested codebase, and the deepest liquidity. Major corporations, financial institutions, and even governments are building on Ethereum because it offers something rare: credibility combined with innovation.

When serious capital enters crypto, Ethereum is usually the first stop.
Proof of Stake and the Green Shift
Ethereum’s transition to proof-of-stake marked one of the most important upgrades in blockchain history. Energy consumption dropped dramatically, scalability improved, and Ethereum became a yield-generating asset through staking.
This was not just a technical upgrade it was a statement. Ethereum proved it can evolve without compromising decentralization or security.

Layer-2 Explosion: Scaling the Future
Ethereum’s ecosystem is now expanding through Layer-2 networks that make transactions faster and cheaper while inheriting Ethereum’s security. This modular design positions Ethereum as the base layer of the internet of value, with infinite scalability potential.

The future of mass adoption runs through Ethereum

Cultural and Economic Gravity
NFTs, Web3 gaming, digital art, DAOs, and tokenized real-world assets all found their first real home on Ethereum. It is where innovation launches first, where narratives are born, and where builders go when they want to change the system not tweak it.
Ethereum doesn’t chase trends.
Trends emerge from Ethereum.
Final Thought
Ethereum is not priced on speculation alone it is valued on usage, adoption, and necessity. Every cycle strengthens its position. Every upgrade expands its reach. Every new application increases demand for block space.
Bitcoin is digital gold.
Etherum is the digital economy itself.
And the world is still early.
